Sandbox_ExtractionMode_SkillBooksGrantXP: Completed Skill Books Grant Direct XP
Enabled by default. Each character can earn direct skill XP once per completed book volume, up to that volume's maximum trained level.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_RequireUpgradeSki: Enabled by default. When disabled, hideout upgrades still require their prerequisite upgrades and supplied items, but do not require a survivor with the listed skill levels. Quest skill requirements are unaffected.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_GrantStarterM9Kit: Enabled by default. Each new survivor receives one M9 pistol and two loaded 9mm magazines. The starter flashlight is unaffected.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_GrantStarterNight: Enabled by default. Each new survivor receives one nightstick equipped in their primary hand.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_GeneratorFuelPerD: Hideout Generator Base Fuel Use (Liters per Day)
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_VehicleRaidBaseFu: Base fuel charged when a vehicle enters a raid and again when it extracts. The final cost also uses Project Zomboid's vehicle-mass, engine-quality, and global gas-consumption multipliers. Entry requires the full amount; extraction may reduce the tank to zero. Set to 0 to disable both charges.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_HideoutVehicleIna: Hideout Vehicle Inactivity Before Swap (Real Minutes)

How long an unoccupied active hideout vehicle must remain unused before another player may return it to its owner's garage and deploy their own. Occupied or raid-reserved vehicles are never considered inactive.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_HotwireExtractedV: Disabled by default. When enabled, every vehicle successfully extracted from a raid is stored as hotwired. This also makes legacy garage vehicles deploy hotwired if their original key registration was not preserved.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_ExtractionHealing:
Disabled: extraction does not alter injuries.

Heal Major Wounds: treats bleeding, fractures, deep wounds, burns, and lodged bullets or glass. Scratches, cuts, bites, wound infections, and Knox infection remain.

Heal Fully: restores the survivor completely, including clearing Knox infection.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_RaidDeathHandling:
Vanilla Death: death and corpse creation are unchanged.

Keep Character - Lose All Equipment: lethal damage instead returns the survivor to the hideout with skills and XP intact, leaving every carried, equipped, and worn item at the field location.

Keep Character - Lose 50 Percent: lethal damage instead returns the survivor with skills and XP intact after exactly half of the remaining eligible equipment is randomly selected for loss. Anything held is always lost in addition. Basic clothing is protected.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_EasierExtractions: Disabled by default. When enabled, firing an extraction flare spawns no initial response zombies and the flare gun produces no zombie-attracting world sound. Other raid hordes and the helicopter's behavior are unchanged.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_ExtractionHordePe: Initial Flare Response Zombies per Player
Number of zombies spawned at the extraction site for each living, connected player participating in the raid.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_BanditAttackWindo: Chance to spawn a hostile Bandits group whenever a recurring attack window expires during a raid. A new window is scheduled after every roll.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_BanditHordeReplac: At horde time, chance to replace the zombie horde with a larger, lightly equipped hostile Bandits group using a mix of melee weapons and firearms.
